flagged.evidence: The proof lists the overlaps as “(2/5,1/2,1/2,2/5,1/2,1/2,2/5,2/5).” Under its propagation rule, for k=1 the pair is (0001,0101), with p_{0001}=(2/5,2/5,1/10,1/10) and p_{0101}=(1/10,2/5,2/5,1/10). They differ only at coordinate 2, so the overlap is sqrt((2/5)(2/5))=2/5, not 1/2. The later lower bound that all overlaps are at least 2/5 remains valid.
